regimes: disjoint baseline scrub-conditioned; not guaranteed cold

checks.ABI_and_memory: Five baseline and four fixed-candidate pointer-to-argument entries; int64 n; stats offset0/5 within23 guarded words. Maximum descriptor allocation41943040 safely covers all five; disjoint scrub16777216. Prepared argument storage remains live across start/launch/stop submission.
checks.preflight: All15 descriptor/pattern pairs plus scrub pair run before any event timing. Full input unchanged, output exact two-arm equality, exterior canaries and expected all16stats independently CPU checked. Per-sample stats recorded; post-cell full-array equality/input/canary checks.
checks.bracket: Only start event, budget increment/guard and kernel launch, stop event inside normal bracket. Allocation, argument setup, copies, reset, synchronization and success logging outside. Event launch gaps can contribute to single-kernel timings; no whole-model claim.
checks.event_preservation: Exact float duration bits/index/elapsed rc logged before finite-duration or stats validation. Analyzer checks every successful sample against original bits. Final scrub mismatch now saves both raw readbacks before failure.
checks.statistics: Per-descriptor median of three within-ABBA mean differences; raw360 samples, paired means/ratios and ranges retained. Each of six pattern/regime scenarios computes signed callcount-weighted deltas and separately sum of positive-clipped deltas. No descriptor selection across scenarios; independently tested.
checks.gate: Maximum whole-scenario optimistic sum >1003.739604ms => INVESTIGATION_ONLY; otherwise PARK_WITHOUT_MODEL_QUALIFICATION. Never a model bound/gain.
checks.safety: Reviewed exact resource/exhaustive prerequisite pins; native300second SIGALRM plus outer watchdog/deadline; GPU0 physical PCI; cooldown/high190W/thermal checks; shared lock; fresh outputs; no API/settings changes; no retries; preserved failures and cleanup.

limitations: Source and host tests only: driver compile and GPU timing unrun by reviewer.
Three quartets per synthetic cell are screening evidence, not confidence-qualified production performance.
Warm/scrub-conditioned labels do not establish cold-cache behavior.
SIGALRM is a process watchdog, not guaranteed instantaneous hardware cancellation.
Preflight output files require about2.29GB disk before compression.
